A dip warning identifies a depression in the road ahead and calls for slowing. A bump warning identifies a raised irregularity ahead and calls for slowing. A soft-shoulder warning means the road edge cannot be treated like the regular traveled surface; use that shoulder only in an emergency. A divided-highway-begins warning advises preparation for a change of lane position as separated roadways begin. A divided-highway-ends warning advises preparation for a lane-position change as the separation ends.
